review_candidates.title: Senior GenAI Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Build and industrialize GenAI solutions (assistants, automation flows, RAG/agent pipelines) for both internal and external use. Autonomously gather, analyze, and evaluate requirements from internal stakeholders for AI/agentic use cases. Profile 6–10 years of professional experience in software engineering & ML/AI. Able to autonomously evaluate requirements for agentic solutions (single-agent vs multi-agent setups) and apply well-known agent frameworks in delivery.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: These are experienced professionals, expected to contribute from day one with strong coding skills, AI/ML expertise, and a proven ability to independently deliver production-grade pilots and prototypes while adhering to Konecta’s engineering and security standards. Autonomously gather, analyze, and evaluate requirements from internal stakeholders for AI/agentic use cases. Profile 6–10 years of professional experience in software engineering & ML/AI. 2+ years hands-on in Generative AI, with proven delivery of RAG/agent-based and agentic deployments. Able to autonomously evaluate requirements for agentic solutions (single-agent vs multi-agent setups) and apply well-known agent frameworks in delivery.
